# v2026.10.41

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.10.41.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.10.41.md).

This release covers **4 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- Reconcile is one list of jobs and invoices, laid out like Jobs and Invoices, with no overlapping rows. ([#213](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/213))
- A Reconcile row opens its own page with the invoice pager on top and the compare table front and centre. ([#213](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/213))
- Jobs and Reconcile share one Filter chip, with one-word fields and icons. ([#213](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/213))
- Page search is one search icon that opens into a box on Jobs, Invoices and Reconcile; the sidebar search stays the way to find anything. ([#213](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/213))
- Send to Xero is a bulk action on ticked Ready invoices, not a bar above the list. ([#217](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/217))
- A Replit publish reads the workspace database level correctly, also after an out-of-order migration, so the database prompt stops listing changes. ([#214](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/214))

## Changes

- Reconcile is a list with the shared Filter chip and bulk "Make invoices"; a row opens the gap with the pager. ([#213](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/213))
- Page search on Jobs, Invoices and Reconcile is a shared search icon. ([#213](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/213))
- Send to Xero moves to the bulk bar on the Ready tab. ([#217](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/217))

## Fixes

- A Replit publish finds the workspace database level after an out-of-order migration. ([#214](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/214))
